segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The lookout first spots the small boat visually; as it converges slowly and ARPA has no firm track, the participant keeps watching and logs it as one to watch rather than urgent.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Decision Point 1 is an intentional non-bias control: using both ARPA and visual sweeps is plausible for low-radar-cross-section craft.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant weighs letting ARPA drive attention against extra manual sweeps and splits attention, adding visual checks because wooden hulls may not show on radar.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a deliberate complementary monitoring strategy and an intended non-bias segment.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: At two miles the lookout reports zigzagging; participant cites the untripped ARPA alarm and keeps monitoring rather than taking early avoiding action.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Decision Point 2 contains deference to ARPA non-escalation over the conflicting lookout report, delaying independent plotting or maneuvering.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: During the squall, the cluster appears at the waypoint of the vivid personal near-miss; attention and evasive planning shift to it while the bulk carrier has tighter CPA, and participant later says the memory drove prioritization.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Decision Point 3 contains vivid personal-memory-driven risk estimation and attention allocation away from the objectively tighter bulk-carrier CPA.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: After both contacts pass clear, participant briefs the Master and recommends an extra lookout for the remaining fishing-activity area based on observed activity.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Decision Point 4 is an intended non-bias recommendation grounded in observed fishing activity.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant says they would independently plot any contact the lookout flags as behaving oddly, regardless of ARPA ranking.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a post-event corrective plan, not an additional manifested bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant says they would rank contacts by actual numbers before letting one feel urgent because it recalls a prior experience.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a post-event corrective plan, not an additional manifested bias instance.
